answer: Count an identity only if random walks launched from the honest core frequently pass through it. Honest nodes mix into one well-connected region, so core walks traverse them often and light each beacon. A sybil cluster is an island reachable only across a narrow lotus-stem of a few real edges; the cut is small, so random routes from the core almost never cross into it no matter how dense it is inside. A farm's thousand heads behind one thin bridge are rarely walked and earn nearly nothing, because traversal frequency, not internal edge count, sets the weight.
